title: 'Orange Is the New Black' Star Taryn Manning Under Fire After Video Shows Her Allegedly Attacking Former Girlfriend - NewsBreak
text:
By Noah Fuller ,
13 hours ago Taryn Manning had a physical altercation with her once-time girlfriend, Holly Hartman , this week in a video obtained by tabloids.
In the minute-long clip, the Orange Is the New Black actress is seen yelling in her studio in Palm Springs, California, as she appears to assault Hartman physically.
“Look what you’ve done to my f–-ing studio,” Manning, 47, said as she threatened to call the police on her girlfriend.
“Call the police. I’ll show them you just attacked me,” Hartman replied.
The two continued to exchange verbal blows, but the context of those statements is unclear in the shaky video.
At the end of the clip, Manning appears to kick a large suitcase at Hartman, with the actress seemingly continuing to attack her former girlfriend as the audio begins to muffle.
Subscribe To Our Cheat Sheet!One week of pop culture news in your inbox! After the video was published on Tuesday, Manning posted a flurry of videos defending herself and providing more context to the situation, while calling violence “never, ever, ever good.”
Manning denies that the person in the video, who appears to be Hartman, is her girlfriend. The actress claims that Hartman has been living in her recording studio, which is preventing her from being homeless.
“She’s living in my office because she’s homeless,” Manning said. “This is a 36-year-old woman that I’ve tried for so long, for 18 years, to try to help.”
In a separate video that appears to be from the same day as the alleged incident, Manning is seen grilling Hartman for the alleged choices she has made with her money.
“You spend your money on weed and methamphetamine,” Manning said to Hartman. “You don’t even buy food for your animals.”
On Wednesday, Manning posted a video seemingly seeking legal action against Hartman for sending the the video to reporters without the full context of the situation, among many other claims.
It is unclear whether either party has taken any official legal action yet.
In 2012, Manning was arrested for assaulting Hartman , who was her makeup artist at the time. The charges against Manning were dropped, but Hartman would file a restraining order against the Hustle & Flow actress in 2016 following yet another physical altercation . Hartman’s restraining order was later denied because it was filed in Los Angeles, but the alleged incident occurred in New York.
